Both work for me — this label version also brings the two related links back together, just by tagging them and then clicking the "Web development" label to filter down to them.

The difference I notice: collections put each link into a named group, while labels tag links and then let me filter to a label. Both get me what I need. If I had to pick, the named collections from Approach 1 feel a touch more natural to me — it matches how I think about tidying links into folders. But labels are perfectly fine too, so I'm happy either way; go with Approach 1 unless there's a reason you'd prefer labels.
